passages:
Sandy: Dave is not going to the movies with us this weekend. It’s the second time this month. It’s strange.
Greg: Well, maybe it’s because he is seeing someone. In fact, I saw him with a beautiful woman at a tea house the other day.
Sandy: What’s the tea, Greg?
Greg: Too bad! They had coffee, not tea.
Sandy: No, Greg. I mean I want to know more about Dave and the woman!
Greg: Oh, I see. Well, they were at a nice tea house on York Street. I was reading when I saw them.
Sandy: And then?
Greg: Dave had a sandwich, and the woman ordered a strawberry pie. And...
Sandy: I am not interested in the food. Get to the point!
Greg: OK. OK. It looked like they had a great time together. They talked about many things like their hobbies, favorite songs, and so on. By the way, Dave called the woman Liz.
Sandy: Aww, that’s sweet. Are they going to meet up again?
Greg: I think so. They talked about visiting the Modern Art Museum or something.
Sandy: Forget about the movie. Let’s go follow Dave this weekend! I want to see the woman in person! What do you say?
Greg: Of course not. We know nothing about this woman because Dave does not want us to know about her. As his best friends, we should just wait until he’s ready to share.
Sandy: All right. Let’s keep to our first plan. See you then.
（likely 可能；dialogue 對話）

【Andrew】Why did Eric shout at me today?
I really don’t understand. I took those photos just to make a great video for him, and I never meant to hurt or laugh at him. During the 8 months, he worked very hard to lose weight for the dance show. Wasn’t it a great idea to take a picture every week to record his changes?

【Nancy】RE: Why did Eric shout at me today?
I almost cried when I was watching the video. To be honest, I already forgot about Eric’s size before watching it. He’s now a lot thinner than before! Maybe Eric was not angry with you. He just felt embarrassed when you showed the video to everyone. Believe me, he will thank you for making the video in the future.

【Joshua】RE: Why did Eric shout at me today?
I like the video, too. It was hard to notice Eric’s changes because we saw him every day. However, the 35 photos in the video showed us his hard work perfectly. In fact, I think Eric liked it, too. He was angry just because you took those photos without telling him first. No one likes that.

【Phoebe】RE: Why did Eric shout at me today?
To give Eric a surprise doesn’t sound like a good reason to me. Eric tried so hard to lose weight, and he doesn’t want anyone to remember his past self. It might be great to make the video for Eric as a gift, but it was a big mistake to play it in front of the class without letting him know first. You’d better say sorry to Eric as soon as possible.
（weight 重量；record 記錄；embarrassed 尷尬的；perfectly 完美地）

Training Date: 2023/06/19
What Should You Do When You See a Bear?
Never Attack, Run, Shout, or Look at Its Eyes!!

▸ If the bear is far away:
Quietly leave that area right away. Do NOT run or make loud noises.
▸ If the bear starts getting close to you:
Slowly and quietly move and leave. Do NOT turn your back on the bear.
▸ If the bear stands on its hind legs:
It might not be trying to attack you. It may just be curious. Bears sometimes stand to look farther. Still, you should back away slowly.
▸ If the bear charges at you:
In most cases, the bear does this to test you. This charge is usually short. It’ll run up to you and then suddenly stop. Then it turns back.
You can ring your bear bell to make the bear go away.
OR
You can wave things in your hand or raise your hands to make yourself look larger.
（hind 後方的；curious 好奇的；charge (at) 猛衝（向）；suddenly 突然）

Here are three living things—three-toed sloths, sloth moths, and trichophilus. They look far different from one another. However, there is a strong tie among them. It may be much more interesting than you think!
【Three-Toed Sloth】Meet the three-toed sloth, probably the slowest animal in the world. These sloths don’t get enough energy from their food, so they move very little to save energy. However, when nature calls, they s-l-o-w-l-y climb down the trees. Although it is dangerous for them to go down to the ground and poop, they still do it once a week. Why don’t they just defecate in the trees?
【Sloth Moth】The sloths have some little friends—sloth moths! These moths live in the hair of the sloths because it’s like a comfortable hotel for them. They need the sloths to defecate on the ground so that they can lay eggs in their poop. The baby insects grow up in the poop. Then, they move back to live in the hair of the sloths when the sloths climb down the trees. After the sloth moths die, their bodies become trichophilus’ food.
【Trichophilus】That’s right. Trichophilus is the third member in this cool circle. It is very special, and people can’t find it anywhere else but on the sloths. Trichophilus makes some parts of the sloths’ bodies look green and helps them hide in the trees. What’s more, the sloths get to eat some trichophilus when they are cleaning their hair. Eating this plant is also a great help to the sloths’ health.
（among 在……之間；defecate 排便；energy 能量；poop 排便；糞便；lay 下蛋）

Ideas from Around — Richard Smith
【Our City, Our Home】
When people say our city is far from being good or convenient enough, I totally agree. However, when they start to get angry at the government and keep asking for more, well, I can’t agree with that. In fact, the government is doing much more than many people think.
Take the benches outside the public library for example. They were there for people to sit on and read a book. Together with the trees, they used to make the library look like a wonderful place. However, some people slept on them for hours, and others enjoyed their food on the benches but didn’t clean them up. In the end, the government had no choice but to remove all the benches to keep the area clean.
The benches show us only a very small part of the problem. To enjoy things in public places, we all should learn to use them in the right way. If some people only think about themselves, they may cause trouble for others. Getting angry with them is surely not helpful. To me, teaching them a lesson by giving them a fine is not enough, either.
We must go further to deal with the problem by starting with young kids in school. It is more important than getting good grades. If we only teach them subjects like English and math, how can we expect them to grow into great citizens in the future? We need lessons to teach our children to take care of our city. This way, we can reach out to the next generation and truly help the city get better. After all, a city can only be good when it has good citizens.
（government 政府；remove 移除；cause 造成；citizen 公民；generation 世代）

【Dengue Fever Spraying Notice】
After the rainy season, the number of dengue fever cases keeps rising. In order to stop it, there will be wide spraying in this area at 10:00 a.m. on July 28. The spraying covers not only the outdoor areas but also the inside space of your house, including your living room, kitchen, bathrooms, and bedrooms. The spraying will last for about 30 minutes.

Before the Spraying:
❶ Please check inside and around your house carefully for any items with water in them and clean them up.
❷ Please put all food, plates, bowls, and so on into drawers or boxes.
❸ Feel free to cover items like sofas and beds. However, your covering should not stop the spraying from going into every corner of the space.
❹ Close all your windows and doors.
❺ Pets must leave. If you have fish, cover your fishbowl and turn off the air pump.
❻ Please hand your key to a neighbor if you aren’t home. We will enter your house with the help of the police when no one is home.

After the Spraying:
❶ Wait for 1 hour after the spraying. Once you enter your house, open the windows and doors to let fresh air in first, and then wait outside for another 30 minutes.
❷ Please be careful as the floor might be a little wet.
❸ The repellent will not hurt your health, but it’s a good idea to wash your hands after you touch the items with the repellent on them.

If you have any questions, please call the Health Department at 12-334-556. Thank you for your help and understanding. Let’s save our town from dengue fever together!
Health Department, Brooklyn
（dengue fever 登革熱；spraying 噴藥；including 包括；pump 幫浦；repellent 驅蟲劑）

There are many stories in the history of music. To some people, Jean-Baptiste Lully’s death is probably the saddest and most surprising one.
Lully was a gifted musician from Italy. He was born in 1632 and was famous for making beautiful music. He showed his interest in music when he was very young. After he moved to France, he learned more and was able to bring his own music to a new level. People loved listening to his music, and he even became King Louis XIV’s favorite.
Lully was good at writing music. Also, he was proud to hold a conducting staff and lead a group of musicians. ＿42＿ It was long, heavy, and not easy to use. However, no one saw that as a problem until January 1687.
In 1687, something sad happened. When Lully was conducting his own music Te Deum, he struck his foot with the conducting staff by mistake. Although doctors tried their best to help him, Lully’s foot got terribly infected in a short time. ＿43＿
Lully’s death marked a turning point in the history of conducting. Now, we have lighter and better tools for conducting. And of course, Lully’s music lives on and keeps bringing joy to people even today.
（musician 音樂家；conducting staff 指揮棒；conduct 指揮；strike 擊中（過去式 struck）；infected 感染的）

questions.e: 從後句「錯過午餐跟晚餐」可知，比賽後睡了超過 12 小時，應用過去式，故選(A)。

questions.q: It’s hard not to ＿＿＿＿ with James. All of his points about the language program are correct. He’s so smart!
questions.e: 後句說他所有的論點都是正確的，表示很難不「同意」James，故選(B)。

questions.q: Kids, ＿＿＿＿ only three rules to follow here, so please keep them in mind before we walk into the museum, OK?
questions.e: 表示「某處有……」要用存在句句型 There is /are...，故選(D)。

questions.q: Nancy decided to take her cat to the doctor because it kept making a ＿＿＿＿ noise when it was eating.
questions.e: 應該是在吃東西時持續發出「奇怪的」聲音，Nancy 才會決定帶寵物貓去看醫生，故選(C)。

questions.q: ＿＿＿＿ Jasmine studied for hours, she finally understood those ideas. Now, she just needs a few more examples.
questions.e: 後句說「終於理解了這些概念」，可知是研讀好幾個小時「之後」，故選(B)。

questions.q:
Dora: What ＿＿＿＿ tonight? I’m free tonight.
Nina: How about going shopping? I want to buy some dresses.
questions.e: 由 Nina 回應「去購物如何？我想買一些洋裝」可知，Dora 問她今晚將要做什麼，用未來式描述或詢問即將發生的事，故選(A)。

questions.q: We must try this restaurant. Every time I walk past it, the ＿＿＿＿ from the inside makes my mouth water.
questions.e: 說話者覺得一定要試試看該餐廳，應該是因為每次經過時，裡面的「氣味」都會讓人流口水，故選(D)。

questions.q:
Kevin: ＿＿＿＿ do you borrow books from the library?
Vicky: Well, it takes me months to finish reading a book, so maybe... once a year.
questions.e: 雖然 Vicky 先說明自己讀完一本書要花很長時間，但最後回答「也許一年一次」，可知 Kevin 問的是頻率，應用 How often 詢問，故選(C)。

questions.q:
Lisa: Why did Peter talk to you for that long at the party? What was it about?
Gary: I’m not hiding anything from you, but... to be honest, they were playing music too ＿＿＿＿, so I couldn’t even hear a word.
questions.e: Gary 一個字都沒聽到，可知現場的音樂播放是很「大聲地」，故選(A)。

questions.q: Mandy’s little brother is turning 10 this year. She is thinking about ＿＿＿＿ him a bike.
questions.e: about 為介系詞，動詞接在其後方當受詞時須用V-ing 形式，故選(D)。

questions.q: Oh, no! The Internet here is ＿＿＿＿ than I thought. I can’t work on the report here.
questions.e: 由 than 可知空格應填入比較級，比較級前可用副詞 much 修飾，表示「比……得多」，故選(D)。

questions.q:
Emily: You know what? It can be ＿＿＿＿ to hike in the mountains without wearing the right shoes.
Jack: That’s for sure. The shoes on your feet may save you or kill you.

questions.e: 後句提到應該要有 50 本，但自己每次都得到不同的數字，可知是需要人幫忙「計數」，故選(A)。

questions.q: Willy was hungry, but he didn’t eat all the pizza. He saved a ＿＿＿＿ for his brother.

questions.q:
Rita: You got up so early this morning.

questions.q: ＿＿＿＿ of the members has to say something in the meeting. No one can just listen.

questions.q:
While reading a piece of news, Tom saw the word “cast” and didn’t know its meaning.
... A touching real-life story is not enough. The team of To Live Again needs to cast someone really good for it. In the story, Gary Pepper leaves everything behind and doesn’t want to get his past back. Who can be the best person to present Gary Pepper on the screen?...
He found several meanings of the word in the dictionary. Which one should Tom choose?
o: To make someone go to a terrible place.
To choose actors for a movie.
questions.e: 由後方描述 Gary Pepper 的故事，又提問「誰能成為最適合在銀幕上呈現 Gary Pepper 的人？」可知，團隊要為其電影「選角」，故選(C)。

questions.q: When Sandy said “What’s the tea,” what was she trying to tell Greg?
o: To be careful with the hot tea.
To say more about Dave’s date.
To find out the name of the tea house.
questions.e: Sandy 在下一次說話時，表示自己說 What’s the tea是指她想知道更多關於 Dave 跟那個女人的事，故選(C)。

questions.q: What is Greg most likely going to do this weekend?
o: Check the woman out with Sandy.
Go to the Modern Art Museum.
questions.e: 由第一句可知，Sandy 跟 Greg 原定要去看電影，雖然最後 Sandy 說要改去跟蹤 Dave，但 Greg 拒絕，因此應該還是會去看電影，故選(B)。

questions.q: What can we learn from the dialogue?
o: Greg and Sandy knew nothing about Liz before Greg saw her with Dave.
Sandy was also at the tea house when Dave and Liz were there.
Greg is less interested in Liz than Sandy because he doesn’t care about Dave.
Sandy was unhappy because Dave used to hide things from her.
questions.e: Dave 沒有對 Greg 和 Sandy 提過任何關於 Liz 的事，兩人是在 Greg 在茶館看到後才知道，之前並不知道，故選(A)。

questions.q: According to the post, how might Eric feel when he shouted at Andrew?（according to 根據）
questions.e: Nancy 提到 Eric 應該是因為尷尬而生氣，Joshua則認為 Eric 是因為在未被告知的情況下被拍照而感到生氣，再由 Phoebe 的敘述可知影片是Andrew 準備的驚喜，可知 Eric 在對 Andrew 大吼時應該是又氣又詫異，故選(A)。

questions.q: Which is 【NOT】 true?
o: During the 8 months, Eric successfully lost some weight.
After finishing making the video, Andrew played it in front of the class.
Joshua tried to understand Eric by putting himself in Eric’s shoes.
All of the students in the class hate the video except Nancy.
questions.e: Joshua 也喜歡那個影片，故(D) 有誤。故選(D)。

questions.q: What might we see in Andrew’s video?
o: There are 35 photos of Eric in a dance show, and he looks thin in all of them.
There are 35 photos of the class in the practice for a dance show.
There are 35 photos of the same boy, and he becomes thinner from the first photo to the last one.
It is a short 35-second video. In it, Eric falls and makes many mistakes when he is practicing dancing.
questions.e: Andrew 提到他每週拍一張來記錄瘦身歷程，Nancy 提到在看影片前她已經忘了 Eric 以前的體型且 Eric 現在瘦多了，Joshua 則提到共有 35 張照片展示了 Eric 的努力，可知影片是由 35 張 Eric 的照片組成，他在每一張照片中逐漸變瘦，故選(C)。

questions.q: What is this Training for?
o: A half-day trip to a public zoo.
A camping trip in the mountains.
A job in an animal hospital.
A visit to a bear museum.
questions.e: 整篇筆記都在寫遇到熊的應對，在山上較有可能遇到熊，可知是山中露營的訓練，故選(B)。

questions.q: What do the notes tell people to do when they see a bear?
o: Turn around and run away as fast as possible.
Wave their hands when it stands on its hind legs.
Ring the bear bell when it charges at them.
Make loud noises when it’s still far away.
questions.e: (A) 不應該背對著熊奔跑；(B) 應該要持續緩慢後退；(D) 不應該發出過大的聲音；僅(C) 正確。故選(C)。

questions.q: Kyle will go to Japan for the first time next month. To learn more about Japan, he decided to join the talk on 6/17. After the talk, he also plans to stay for another hour to ask for some help with buying tickets. He is not a member, and he doesn’t plan to buy a package tour. o: It costs at least NT$9,900 to take their 3-day trip to Thailand.
Trip Star is open only for 2 hours on Saturdays.
Their members can get a better price when booking a trip.
Trip Star is having a sale to celebrate their new opening.
questions.e: (B) 星期六是有兩小時的講座，不是只營業兩小時；(C) 廣告中未提及；(D) 廣告中並未提及其促銷是為了慶祝新開幕，且已有數以千計的人對Trip Star 的服務感到滿意，可知它應該不是新開幕，僅(A) 正確。故選(A)。

questions.q: What happens after a three-toed sloth climbs down a tree to defecate?
o: It moves quickly back to the tree because it’s dangerous.
Sloth moths get to lay eggs in its poop.
Trichophilus starts to grow in its poop.
It usually stays on the ground for a week.
questions.e: 由樹懶蛾的段落介紹可知，牠們會在樹懶爬下樹排便後在其糞便中產卵，長大成蟲的樹懶蛾會再回到樹懶的毛髮中，故選(B)。

questions.q: According to the reading, which is true?（according to 根據）
o: Three-toed sloths look green because there is trichophilus in their hair.
Sloth moths live and die in the sloths’ poop.
We can easily find trichophilus in a park.
Sloth moths lay eggs in the hair of the sloths because it is warm and good for the eggs.
questions.e: (B) 樹懶蛾成年後會住在樹懶的毛髮中直至死亡；(C) trichophilus 是一種特別的綠藻，僅在樹懶身上可見；(D) 樹懶蛾會產卵於樹懶的糞便中，而不是毛髮中；僅(A) 正確。故選(A)。

questions.q: What are the right answers for each blank?
questions.e: 由文章可知，樹懶在清理毛髮時會吃到綠藻，而那對其健康有益，故①填入「綠藻」；由介紹樹懶蛾的段落可知，樹懶蛾從卵中孵化後會先住在樹懶的糞便中，長大後才移居至樹懶的毛髮中，故②填入「糞便」；由介紹綠藻的段落可知，綠藻為一種寄居於樹懶毛髮中的植物，故③填入「植物」、④填入「毛髮」，故選(D)。

questions.q: What does Richard Smith think of the city government?
o: It never spends people’s money wisely.
It actually does a lot to make the city better.
It does many things, but most of them are not helpful at all.
It should learn to listen to its people carefully.
questions.e: 由第一段最後一句可知，Richard Smith 覺得其實政府做得遠比人們想像的還多，故選(B)。

questions.q: Why did Richard Smith talk about the benches outside the public library?
o: He wanted to give an example of people’s wrong ways of using the things in a public place.
He brought that up to tell people to remember the history of the city.
He wanted everyone to take action to get those benches back.
He talked about that because he was really mad at the government.
questions.e: 由第三∼四段可知，Richard Smith 的核心重點是，整個城市的提升需要優秀的市民，而第二段舉的圖書館長椅即是沒有優秀市民的例子，故 RichardSmith 提及此事是為了佐證市民沒有用正確的方式使用公共設施一事，故選(A)。

questions.q: According to Richard Smith, why is it important to teach kids about taking care of the city?（according to 根據）
o: It helps them learn English and math better.
It makes them use public places more often.
It helps them become better citizens in the future.
It gives them the power to rule other people.
questions.e: 由第四段可知，Richard Smith 認為要從小開始進行公民教育，觸及下一代才能幫助城市更好，故選(C)。

questions.q: Mr. Chang found this notice in his mailbox today. If he waits outside his house during the spraying, when can he enter his house for the first time after the spraying?
questions.e: 由噴藥後的第一點可知，噴藥後要等 1 小時才能進去開門窗，然後要再出去等 30 分鐘進行通風。噴藥從 10 點開始持續約 30 分鐘，故會於 10:30左右結束，陳先生可進門開門窗通風的時間最早為 11:30 後，故選(B)。

questions.q: Who failed to read through the notice and didn’t follow the rules?
o: Mike. After he entered his house, he opened all the windows and doors right away.
Kyle. He sent his two cats to a friend’s place on the early morning of July 28th.
Monica. Before the spraying, she put all her cups and bowls into a drawer.
Jessie. She kept her bedroom closed and didn’t let anyone get into it during the spraying.
questions.e: 公告寫到噴藥範圍包含臥室。緊閉臥室房門且不讓任何人進入的 Jessie 應該沒有仔細閱讀公告，故選(D)。

questions.q: 第 42 格應填入：
o: In fact, a lot of musicians in France wanted Lully to teach and to lead them.
The conducting staff of Lully’s time was very different from today’s conducting tool.
To Lully, leading a group of musicians was much easier than writing music.
But Lully never thought about killing anyone with the conducting staff.
questions.e: 空格前一句提到了指揮棒，後一句則描述指揮棒又長又重且不易使用，可知空格是在描述 Lully時代的指揮棒與現今的非常不同，故選(B)。

questions.q: 第 43 格應填入：
o: He even wrote several songs about his days in the hospital.
After that, Lully could only use his left hand to hold the conducting staff.
This proud musician almost died, and it took him a very long time to get well.
Lully became very sick and passed away in March of that year.
questions.e: 前一句提到 Lully 的腳嚴重感染，下一段的第一句則提到 Lully 的死亡成為了指揮史上的轉折點，可知 Lully 在受傷不久後過世，故選(D)。
